claspgroup-clasp-group:ashbyhq:01461ef9-.title: Manager of Information Security
claspgroup-clasp-group:ashbyhq:01461ef9-.description: MANAGER OF INFORMATION SECURITY Team: Information Security Reports to: CTO Location: Remote (US, EST/CST hours) Manages: IT/TechOps (1) ABOUT US Clasp is a Forbes Fintech 50, SHRM-backed company tackling two hard problems at once: helping employers attract and retain talent in critical fields, and easing the student debt crisis. We're at a Series B inflection point, growing fast, with enterprise customers and partner banks who hold us to a high security bar. WHY THIS ROLE We're an AI-first company with a genuinely strong technical team and solid foundations already in place including a running SOC 2 program, a modern GCP infrastructure, a well-managed macOS/Windows fleet, and an engineering culture that ships. Your mission is to take ownership of the information security program, lead our Information Technology team, and pair with engineering leadership and AI Labs on the deep technical work. This is the rare security role reporting to the CTO where you get real ownership on day one without inheriting a mess. If you're the kind of security leader who'd rather stand up a SIEM, harden a Terraform pipeline, and build your own tooling than manage a stack of vendors, this role was built for you. WHAT YOU'LL OWN - SOC 2, Vanta & governance. Run our SOC 2 program end to end, own evolution of our Information Security policies, own our Vanta instance, run events such as business continuity drills, and represent information security in our Risk + Compliance committee. - IT/TechOps. Lead and collaborate with our IT/TechOps team across corporate IT and security: laptop procurement, MDM, onboarding/offboarding, SaaS vendor management and hardening, incident response, data loss protection, and more. Together you'll set direction and grow the function and the team as we scale. - Vendor diligence & security questionnaires. Own third-party security reviews, and be the front line for inbound customer and partner-bank security questionnaires - SIEM, Vulnerability Management & IDS. Configure our SIEM, build the alerting that gives us real signal without noise, and manage vendor relationships for real proactive visibility and risk reductions. - Cloud & access security (GCP). Pair with technical leaders to advance our cloud posture, IAM (JIT privilege escalation, group-based access), and platform hardening. - AppSec & secure SDLC. Partner with engineering to advance secure SDLC in a rapidly changing agentic world. Ensure dependency and vulnerability scanning is effective, CI/CD and pipelines are hardened, and new features have robust threat modeling. - AI security agents. Work with the CTO and AI Labs to run build vs buy analysis for all categories of agentic security work: detection/triage, evidence collection, questionnaire drafting, access reviews and more. Additionally, ensure all other deployed agents operate securely.. HOW WE THINK ABOUT SECURITY IN THE AGE OF AI The security landscape in 2026 is changing fast. We want to implement best-of-breed vendors and roll up our sleeves to engineer in-house solutions when it makes the most sense. We don’t want to just throw head count or complex solutions at a problem that can instead be automated and configured in depth to be more resilient than brittle commercial solutions. You'll be hands-on and genuinely exhilarated to work closely with our technical teams to build and maintain internal security capabilities across SIEM, IDS, and more. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - CISSP certification. - 5+ years on a security team. - Startup experience — you've worked somewhere scrappy, not only at large/mega companies. - Compliance in the room — you've been at a company that achieved SOC 2 or ISO 27001. - A technical foundation — a semi-technical degree (Information Systems or similar) or a few years of hands-on technical work (scripting, web development, automation, data analysis, etc.). - AI builder's instinct — comfortable scripting, prototyping, and using AI and modern tooling to solve problems efficiently. - Stro

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4a96318d-75a7-.title: Director, Supply Chain Operations
jobgether-jobgether:lever:4a96318d-75a7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Supply Chain Operations based in the United States. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for the execution engine behind a rapidly scaling healthcare supply chain. You will oversee the systems, pharmacy network, and fulfillment operations that move prescriptions from order to patient delivery. The role combines operational leadership, systems thinking, process transformation, and vendor management in a regulated environment. You will work closely with Product and Engineering to replace manual processes with scalable technology and reliable infrastructure. Your work will directly influence service levels, fulfillment quality, cost efficiency, compliance, and patient experience. As a builder and people leader, you will develop multidisciplinary teams while strengthening processes, documentation, and operational resilience. This is an opportunity to shape a critical function at the intersection of healthcare, technology, pharmacy, and high-growth operations. Own Systems & Formulary: Lead the configuration that determines how medication orders flow, including SKU and formulary builds, state-specific routing, product attributes, titration, cadence, pharmacy assignment, and integration health. Establish strong validation practices to ensure configuration accuracy and patient-safe execution. Lead Network & Fulfillment Operations: Oversee the pharmacy partner network, including relationships, capacity, pricing, sourcing, onboarding, and nationwide coverage, while managing end-to-end fulfillment, exceptions, carrier issues, cold-chain requirements, and returns. Drive service levels and routing performance: Establish and improve fulfillment SLAs while balancing service quality, operational efficiency, and cost. Redesign exception-management processes to reduce manual backlogs as volumes increase. Partner with Product and Engineering: Translate operational challenges into clear technical requirements, participate in prioritization and scope decisions, and validate scalable tools for order triage, status visibility, network management, and formulary configuration. Transform operational processes: Rebuild workflows designed for rapid growth into scalable, repeatable processes spanning order flow, pharmacy operations, Patient Support, credentialing, and related functions without disrupting ongoing operations. Build operational documentation: Create reliable reference materials covering SKU composition, temperature and handling requirements, workflows, and partner processes so teams can self-serve and escalate only true exceptions. Own launch and operational readiness: Partner with clinical teams on new products and formulations, driving testing, state coverage, SKU configuration, pharmacy readiness, and launches, including service and regulatory changes. Support quality and compliance: Work with Quality and Compliance teams to ensure configuration, routing, and fulfillment processes are prepared for audits and inspections, including requirements associated with cGMP and state pharmacy boards. Lead and develop multidisciplinary teams: Manage leaders and individual contributors across Systems & Formulary, Network Partnerships, Fulfillment Order Issues, and new product rollout. Hire effectively, establish clear ownership, manage performance, and reduce key-person dependency. Champion automation and continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to automate workflows, strengthen data capture, improve operational visibility, and increase scalability without proportional increases in manual effort. Requirements 8+ years of experience in operations, fulfillment, systems, pharmacy operations, or a related field, including 4+ years of people leadership with experience managing managers or leads. Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience. Proven experience leading multidisciplinary team

jobgether-jobgether:lever:516535aa-f944-.title: CRM & Communications Coordinator
jobgether-jobgether:lever:516535aa-f944-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a CRM & Communications Coordinator based in Ireland. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of CRM and high-volume communications across a growing multi-brand portfolio. You will ensure landlords and tenants receive the right information, through the right channel, at the right time. Working in a fast-paced, product-focused environment, you will manage email operations, audience segmentation and recurring communications at scale. You will help build repeatable systems that make it easy to integrate newly acquired brands into a consistent communications infrastructure. The role combines operational discipline, clear copywriting, data analysis and process improvement with hands-on CRM execution. You will use automation and AI tools to reduce repetitive work while continuously improving engagement, deliverability and communication quality. This is an ideal opportunity for an organised, self-directed CRM professional who enjoys creating structure and scalable processes in a high-growth environment. Own and manage the Mailchimp database across multiple brands, including contact imports, list hygiene, unsubscribes, bounces and data accuracy. Build and maintain detailed audience segments based on contact type, brand, geography and lifecycle stage to ensure communications reach the appropriate audiences. Plan, deploy, schedule and monitor high-volume email communications while maintaining strong deliverability and sender reputation. Manage the communications calendar, including monthly newsletters, regulatory updates, platform announcements and tenant-facing messages, adapting shared templates for individual brands. Monitor and report on key email performance indicators such as open rates, click-through rates and unsubscribes, using insights to improve segmentation, timing and messaging. Onboard newly acquired brands into the CRM infrastructure by importing and cleaning contact lists, establishing segments, creating templates and implementing recurring communication schedules. Develop and maintain a reusable library of email templates, copy blocks and brand assets to accelerate future brand onboarding and ensure consistency. Use Zapier and AI-powered tools to automate repetitive content-production activities and CRM workflows as the portfolio expands. Maintain clear documentation covering CRM processes, workflows and best practices to ensure consistency, scalability and effective knowledge transfer. Support the creation and adaptation of visual assets for email communications and templates using tools such as Canva and Figma. Manage Google Business Profile activities across the wider portfolio. Requirements Experience working within a mature CRM environment, ideally in technology, e-commerce, fintech or another fast-growth business where communications are managed at scale. Hands-on experience with CRM and email marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, HubSpot, Klaviyo or similar systems, including audience management, campaign execution and automation. Practical understanding of email infrastructure and deliverability, including sender domains, authentication, list hygiene and sender reputation. Ability to work confidently with email templates and make basic HTML/CSS adjustments when required. Strong understanding of effective email copywriting, with the ability to review, refine and improve content produced by others. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence engaging with UK-based stakeholders. Highly organised and self-managing, with the ability to work effectively even when information or processes are incomplete. Strong process-oriented mindset, with the ability to standardise fragmented workflows, document processes and create repeatable systems. Comfortable taking a hands-on approach while continuously looking for ways to improve how work is performed. Proact

jobgether-jobgether:lever:536d8658-7976-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Banking Onboarding Manager based in Italy. As a Banking Onboarding Manager, you will take ownership of complex corporate banking and EMI onboarding across multiple jurisdictions and high-risk industries. You will act as a key link between internal Finance and Legal teams and external banking partners, relationship managers, and compliance officers. Your expertise will help secure and maintain critical corporate accounts while ensuring demanding underwriting and regulatory requirements are met. You will manage KYC, KYB, and AML processes, coordinate detailed corporate documentation, and keep applications moving efficiently from submission through approval. The role requires strong knowledge of international banking, complex ownership structures, and compliance requirements, combined with persistence and excellent organization. You will also support ongoing banking relationships through annual reviews, transaction queries, and corporate structure updates. This is a highly autonomous, globally oriented role where your work directly supports the stability and scalability of essential financial operations. Own end-to-end onboarding and account-opening processes for operational and client bank and EMI accounts across multiple jurisdictions. Manage banking applications within high-risk industries, ensuring all requirements are understood, documented, and addressed accurately. Gather, review, structure, and submit corporate legal files, UBO ownership documentation, and operational flowcharts required for bank underwriting. Build and maintain strong working relationships with bank relationship managers, compliance officers, EMIs, and other financial partners. Track active applications closely, proactively follow up on outstanding requirements, and resolve issues to minimize account setup delays. Lead KYC, KYB, and AML processes, including complex onboarding cases, annual reviews, and ad-hoc compliance inquiries. Coordinate responses to transaction-related questions and provide banking partners with accurate and timely supporting information. Manage annual bank reviews and ensure corporate accounts remain compliant with changing requirements. Communicate corporate structure changes to relevant banking and financial partners and coordinate any resulting documentation or review processes. Support Finance and Legal teams with substance requirements across the corporate holding structure. Interpret and coordinate legal documentation such as Certificates of Incorporation, Registers of Directors, Incumbency Certificates, Powers of Attorney, and apostilled documents. Help manage banking and payment relationships across international payment routes, including SEPA and SWIFT. Maintain clear records of onboarding progress, documentation, requests, approvals, and outstanding actions. Identify potential onboarding or compliance bottlenecks early and work proactively with internal and external stakeholders to resolve them. Contribute to the ongoing improvement of banking onboarding processes, documentation standards, and partner-management practices. Requirements 3+ years of hands-on experience opening and managing corporate bank or EMI accounts, ideally within iGaming, cryptocurrency, high-risk FinTech, or another highly regulated environment. Strong understanding of complex UBO and corporate ownership structures and the documentation required to evidence them. Proven knowledge of bank underwriting requirements, apostilled documentation, and international corporate banking processes. Deep understanding of KYC, KYB, and AML requirements, including AML regulations and Source of Wealth (SoW) and Source of Funds (SoF) assessments. Strong legal literacy and confidence working with corporate documentation, including M&A documents, Certificates of Incorporation, Registers of Directors, Incumbency Certificates, Powers of Attorne
